svg.text: Compute Grouping Densities — How the Algorithm Works
20×5 hand-built fixture: 5 features grouped into 2 parents
Each row above is a Feature; the number inside is the FeatureId.
Each parent's child features plus their contiguous-list neighbors form the 'touched set'.
Non-contiguous links (dashed arcs) reach farther neighbors. The touched sets grow; densities shrink.
